r1FindingResolution.reason: TRI now includes the full snapshot path/mode/content inventory and resolution inputs; additions and deletions invalidate carry-forward. No narrower closure is admitted without an independently reviewed soundness specification. Input triggers are separate from detector outputs.
Water-filling reaches min(100, corpus count) separately per stratum and evidence set. The former 29-family counterexample now draws 72 + 28 = 100; selection and sampled denominators are explicit.

The guard uses verified true/corpus count and an optimistic upper bound. An unweighted sample ratio cannot qualify the guard; pending and unlabelled populations remain distinct. OI-17 is explicitly not adopted.
M3 prohibits repository-controlled execution, requires verified non-executing tool modes, and defers executing tools to explicit M5 authorization. Confinement is no longer treated as permission.

Linux taskstats provides an identified own-address-space counter, and unsupported or missing counters are incomplete. The registration/completion protocol still cannot establish a complete historical inventory or select the terminal thread-group counter unambiguously.
Required Q2 repository populations and line counts, Q3/Q6 yield denominators, and per-rule Q7 populations, histograms and dispositions now have carriers. Measured Q7 requires nonempty rule rows.

Incomplete sample arrays, typed reasons, non-Q6 status, batch identity and final selection are supplied. Operational-record joins and runner observations still lack batch scope when both batches share an envelope.

The baseline places Rust and syntax oracles before day zero and freezes TS by day six; reviewed freezes precede T1 producer runs and are enforced. OI-12 explicitly lists the pending plan edits. The new slip calculation has a separate error.

requiredFindings.title: Do not infer complete lifetime RSS accounting from an empty cgroup and known exits
requiredFindings.problem: The complete condition covers only registered lifetimes. Connector and taskstats delivery can lose events; a short-lived child can disappear between cgroup.procs reads with its notifications lost, leaving populated=0 and all known exits collected. These conditions do not prove that every historical descendant was accounted for. Per-task exit records also occur for individual threads, while lifetimes are deduplicated by tgid; the design does not select the final thread-group record or define complete draining.
requiredFindings.counterexample: A child allocates a peak and exits before the next inventory read. Its fork/exit and accounting messages are lost. All registered processes have counters and the cgroup becomes empty, so the stated completion test can accept an understated sum. Separately, a leader may exit before a worker thread raises the shared address-space peak; accepting the first record for the tgid understates that lifetime.
requiredFindings.impact: An incomplete process inventory or premature counter can be emitted as a complete RSS result and potentially qualify a budget.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Specify acknowledged pre-launch connector/taskstats subscriptions covering every permitted CPU, event-loss/continuity checks, stable identity acquisition, and an explicit terminal drain/completion rule. Any overflow, sequence gap, subscription failure, unknown/unjoinable identity, or missing terminal counter must force incomplete; empty cgroup snapshots cannot repair lost history. Define process-terminal record selection and de-duplication for the pinned kernel, such as the final per-task AGROUP record joined through ac_tgid, rather than the first thread record or summed thread counters. Extend the planned K1c calibration/rejection cases to cover short-lived and multithreaded processes and loss handling.

requiredFindings.title: Give operational records and runner observations an explicit batch join
requiredFindings.r1Relation: Remaining part of C2-Q0-R1-07; also affects r1 observation N04
requiredFindings.problem: Both first and retry batches must share one envelope, but operationalRecords identifies only workloadId/runIndex plus a digest and disclosure flag. Those indexes recur across workflow/reset/control cells and retries. runner.observations is one closed object, although the design requires observations for each batch. No declared lookup binds either evidence carrier to a particular q6 batch.
requiredFindings.counterexample: For the same workload, both batches contain measured run index 0 and have different operational records and pre-batch load averages. The q6 rows have distinct batchIds, but the carrier cannot identify which record or observation belongs to each row.
requiredFindings.impact: A reviewer cannot reconstruct or validate the retained first/final batches, their phase/reuse evidence, or the quiet-run admission evidence.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Add a required batchId join to operational-record rows, with explicit run-slot semantics, or place ordered record references directly in each batch. Carry observations as batch-keyed rows or required batch references. Define semantic validation for canonical IDs, unambiguous joins, duplicate/orphan evidence, and required retained-batch coverage; allow missing evidence only through the specified incomplete/absence state.

requiredFindings.title: Recompute K2 slip slack through F1 to H to J2
requiredFindings.r1Relation: New r2 arithmetic error; the r1 baseline freeze defect is resolved
requiredFindings.problem: The four-day slack statement compares F2 to the original J3 start but holds H and J2 fixed. H also depends on F1. Under the design's stated model that delayed first T1 activity shifts the F branch, three days of actual F1 delay already extend the host chain.

analyticIllustration.assumptions: Actual F1 delay d; other stated branch/day-zero assumptions hold and O2_selected is at most day 24.

requiredFindings.impact: The record overstates delay tolerance in the conditional 26-day schedule.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Replace the four-day assertion with dependency-aware formulas. Only two days of actual F1 delay fit. If oracle slip s is measured from the planned day-six freeze, its one-day margin gives d=max(0,s-1), so three days of oracle slip fit and the fourth extends the chain. Reflect the corrected consequences in the OI-12 update list, or explicitly use a different authoring/testing schedule and recompute its dependencies.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Restrict the error-free minimum wording to the CP branch
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The statement that any error requires more families is false for the product bound. At 299 families, 298 precisions of 1 and one of 999999/1000000 give L >= 0.990030 * 0.999999 = 0.99002900997 > 0.99. If these are fully adjudicated, the pooled guard also passes. The formal product decision rule is correct; qualify the prose and distinguish the CP one-error requirement of 473.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Make the hypothetical OI-17 cost reduction conditional
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The 29-by-4 example draws all 116 findings under current water-filling. A forced 100-finding sample is not guaranteed to pass the proposed alpha/29 hypergeometric guard: in an incompletely observed four-finding family, an all-true sample can still have probability at least 1/4 when one unobserved finding is false, much larger than 0.05/29. Approval of that inference rule alone does not establish the stated sufficiency. Keep the current 260-vote estimate, and qualify or withdraw the prospective 224-vote estimate.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Change exactly when to guaranteed when in the allocation explanation
nonBlockingObservations.observation: At least 100 families guarantees one sampled finding per family, but fewer than 100 singleton families also receive one each. This is a wording error; the formal branch condition at lines 375-376 is correct.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Assign sample/reason consistency to the envelope validator
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The incomplete variant permits null samples with seven empty reason lists. Define cross-field invariants tying unavailable slots to typed reasons and reconciling phase presence/absence and aggregate availability. This does not permit a within-budget result because the incomplete status and q6Labelled=false are enforced.

r1NonBlockingResolution.reason: Family-weighted estimand and additional CP premise are explicit; OI-4/OI-5 remain successor decisions.
Rounded-down reference values and all-success boundary qualification are corrected. Error wording still needs the distinction recorded in C2-Q0-R2-N01.
The unperformed simulation claim is withdrawn; this record labels its numbers as arithmetic, not measurements.
Input/output separation, rater slots and permanent exposure tracking are supplied. Runner observation fields exist but their batch scope remains C2-Q0-R2-02.
Source citations are tightened and Rust refactoring eligibility is restricted to the stated non-expansion domain.

checkResults.result: Sound floor/allocation; no new required finding.
Sound deterministic bounds and conservative status order; OI-17 not adopted.
Counter source is credible, but completeness protocol needs C2-Q0-R2-01.

By static inspection: missing required denominators, measured Q7 without nonempty rules, within results with null RSS samples, incomplete results marked Q6-labelled, and unknown run reasons are rejected by the relevant shapes. Remaining carrier issue is C2-Q0-R2-02; consistency note is N04. No validator was run.
Baseline freeze ordering resolves r1. New slip arithmetic needs C2-Q0-R2-03.

openItemAssessment.OI-17: A new inference rule awaiting approval; the current conservative guard remains valid. Its open status alone is not a required finding.
openItemAssessment.OI-18: Explicit macOS incomplete RSS is conservative. A macOS qualification lane still needs an own-counter source; absence is disclosed rather than filled in.
openItemAssessment.OI-12: The pending M3-PLAN edits are explicitly listed. They must incorporate the corrected slip arithmetic; this review does not require editing the plan before the design is accepted.

verification.method: Read-only static review of both r2 subjects, retained r1 subjects/review, governing local design references and primary Linux documentation/source; analytic allocation, bound and schedule checks.
